title: MySpeed
descript: MySpeed runs periodic internet speed tests and keeps a history of download, upload and latency results. It can also test multiple interfaces and show them on a dashboard. This package runs the official Docker Hub image as a non-root container and keeps its database and downloaded test binaries in the application data folder.
important: Open the web UI to start a test or enable scheduled tests; results are stored in /Volume1/DockerAppData/myspeeddocker/. The container runs as uid 1000 and needs outbound internet access to reach the speed-test servers. Needs DockerEngine; configure a registry mirror if Docker Hub is unreachable. Back up the data folder before uninstalling with data removal. Plain HTTP on the LAN.
